title: Short-cycling at the boutique

dispatch.complaint: The unit keeps turning on and off and it's not keeping up.

faults.description: Refrigerant leak at the liquid-line Schrader core. System undercharged.
LPC1 opens as suction drops. Switch is working correctly.

readings.txt_tstat: Thermostat: Cool, setpoint 72°F, space 76°F. Y1 and G on.
readings.txt_controller: Controller: multiple low-pressure trips logged on circuit 1. ⚠ Code/LED pattern not verified.
readings.txt_look_unit: Compressor runs 2-3 minutes, stops, restarts after the anti-short-cycle delay.
readings.txt_look_condenser: Coil OK. Oily residue around the liquid-line service port.
readings.txt_look_evap: Filters clean. Frost on the lower distributor tubes. Belt good.

hints: Hook up gauges and calculate superheat and subcooling.
High superheat AND low subcooling: what's missing from the system?
Is the LPS lying, or telling you the truth?

diagnosis.label: Low refrigerant charge (leak)
diagnosis.feedback: Low suction, high superheat, low subcooling, oil at a Schrader. Textbook.

diagnosis.label: Defective LPS
diagnosis.feedback: The LPS is doing its job. Suction is really low.

diagnosis.label: Dirty filter / low airflow
diagnosis.feedback: Filters are clean, and low airflow gives LOW superheat, not high.

diagnosis.label: TXV stuck closed / restriction
diagnosis.feedback: A restriction also gives high superheat, but subcooling would be HIGH (charge stacks up in the condenser). Yours is low.

diagnosis.label: Condenser fan problem
diagnosis.feedback: Fan's running, head is LOW. Opposite symptom.

repair.label: Leak check, replace Schrader core, evacuate, weigh in charge
repair.feedback: Leak fixed, charge restored, compressor stays on.

repair.label: Top off charge and leave
repair.feedback: Runs today, short again next month. EPA 608 also expects you to repair leaks, not just top off.

repair.label: Replace LPS
repair.feedback: New switch, same low charge. Trips again.

idealPath.why: Oil at the Schrader: there's your leak.

debrief: Superheat and subcooling read together pin it down. High SH + low SC = undercharge. High SH + high SC = restriction. Low SH + high SC = overcharge. The LPS wasn't broken; it was the messenger.
